vocabulary_groups.title: Inspiration sources and theme words
vocabulary_groups.description: Core words for naming where a fashion idea comes from.

items.definition_en: The source of a design idea.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The idea or image that starts the design.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A ideia ou imagem que inicia o design.
items.example_sentence_en: My inspiration is the ocean.
items.example_sentence_pt: My inspiration is the ocean.
items.professional_context_en: Inspiration is the main Week 12 concept word for concept boards and sketch explanations.
items.professional_context_pt: Inspiration e a principal palavra da Semana 12 para paines de conceito e explicacoes de croqui.
items.translation_notes_pt: Use como ponte para inspiracao.

items.definition_en: The place, image, memory, or idea that gives the design direction.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Where the design idea comes from.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: De onde vem a ideia do design.
items.example_sentence_en: The source is a city photo.
items.example_sentence_pt: The source is a city photo.
items.professional_context_en: Source helps students explain one direct starting point for a look or sketch.
items.professional_context_pt: Source ajuda os alunos a explicar um ponto de partida direto para um look ou croqui.
items.translation_notes_pt: Use como ponte para fonte.

items.definition_en: An image, object, or idea used to guide a design.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Something the designer looks at for ideas.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Algo que o designer observa para ter ideias.
items.example_sentence_en: This photo is my reference.
items.example_sentence_pt: This photo is my reference.
items.professional_context_en: Reference supports inspiration-board and sketch-explanation language in studio work.
items.professional_context_pt: Reference apoia a linguagem de painel de inspiracao e explicacao de croqui no estudio.
items.translation_notes_pt: Explique que aqui significa referencia visual de design, nao referencia bibliografica.

items.definition_en: The main idea that organizes the design.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The main idea of the design.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A ideia principal do design.
items.example_sentence_en: The theme is movement.
items.example_sentence_pt: The theme is movement.
items.professional_context_en: Theme helps students organize source words into one simple concept direction.
items.professional_context_pt: Theme ajuda os alunos a organizar palavras de fonte em uma direcao simples de conceito.
items.translation_notes_pt: Use como ponte para tema.

vocabulary_groups.title: Common inspiration areas
vocabulary_groups.description: Frequent source categories for beginner design-rationale work.

items.definition_en: The natural world, such as water, leaves, flowers, or sky.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The world of plants, water, sky, and animals.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: O mundo de plantas, agua, ceu e animais.
items.example_sentence_en: This design is inspired by nature.
items.example_sentence_pt: This design is inspired by nature.
items.professional_context_en: Nature is a high-frequency and visually clear source for beginner inspiration language.
items.professional_context_pt: Nature e uma fonte frequente e visualmente clara para a linguagem inicial de inspiracao.
items.translation_notes_pt: Use como ponte para natureza.

items.definition_en: An urban place with streets, buildings, and strong visual structure.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A place with streets and buildings.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Um lugar com ruas e edificios.
items.example_sentence_en: The colors come from the city.
items.example_sentence_pt: The colors come from the city.
items.professional_context_en: City helps students connect urban references to straight lines, contrast, and practical looks.
items.professional_context_pt: City ajuda os alunos a ligar referencias urbanas a linhas retas, contraste e looks praticos.
items.translation_notes_pt: Use como ponte para cidade.

items.definition_en: Sound and rhythm used as a design source.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Songs or rhythm that give a design idea.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Musicas ou ritmo que dao uma ideia de design.
items.example_sentence_en: The mood comes from music.
items.example_sentence_pt: The mood comes from music.
items.professional_context_en: Music helps students explain movement, rhythm, and energetic styling choices.
items.professional_context_pt: Music ajuda os alunos a explicar movimento, ritmo e escolhas de estilo energeticas.
items.translation_notes_pt: Use como ponte para musica.

items.definition_en: Buildings and structural forms used as a design source.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Building shapes and strong lines.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Formas de edificios e linhas fortes.
items.example_sentence_en: The lines are inspired by architecture.
items.example_sentence_pt: The lines are inspired by architecture.
items.professional_context_en: Architecture supports structured, line-based, and elegant design explanations.
items.professional_context_pt: Architecture apoia explicacoes de design estruturadas, baseadas em linhas e elegantes.
items.translation_notes_pt: Use como ponte para arquitetura.

items.definition_en: Clothing ideas that come from everyday city fashion.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Fashion ideas from real people in the street.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Ideias de moda de pessoas reais na rua.
items.example_sentence_en: This look is inspired by street style.
items.example_sentence_pt: This look is inspired by street style.
items.professional_context_en: Street style helps students name casual urban fashion references in moodboards and sketch talk.
items.professional_context_pt: Street style ajuda os alunos a nomear referencias de moda urbana casual em moodboards e explicacoes de croqui.
items.translation_notes_pt: Explique como estilo de rua ou moda urbana do dia a dia.

items.definition_en: Paintings, drawings, or other visual works used as a design source.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Pictures or creative visual work that give design ideas.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Quadros ou trabalhos visuais criativos que dao ideias de design.
items.example_sentence_en: The color idea comes from art.
items.example_sentence_pt: The color idea comes from art.
items.professional_context_en: Art helps students connect gallery, painting, and illustration references to fashion ideas.
items.professional_context_pt: Art ajuda os alunos a ligar referencias de galeria, pintura e ilustracao a ideias de moda.
items.translation_notes_pt: Use como ponte para arte visual, nao apenas habilidade artistica.

items.definition_en: Past fashion periods, styles, or garments used as a design source.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Fashion ideas from the past.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Ideias de moda que vem do passado.
items.example_sentence_en: This silhouette is inspired by fashion history.
items.example_sentence_pt: This silhouette is inspired by fashion history.
items.professional_context_en: History helps students explain archival, vintage, and period-fashion references in design work.
items.professional_context_pt: History ajuda os alunos a explicar referencias de arquivo, vintage e moda de epoca no trabalho de design.
items.translation_notes_pt: Explique como historia da moda ou referencia do passado, nao apenas a disciplina escolar.

items.definition_en: A personal remembered image, object, or feeling used as a design source.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A personal idea from something you remember.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma ideia pessoal que vem de algo que voce lembra.
items.example_sentence_en: This detail comes from a family memory.
items.example_sentence_pt: This detail comes from a family memory.
items.professional_context_en: Memory helps students name personal inspiration sources such as photos, keepsakes, and family textiles.
items.professional_context_pt: Memory ajuda os alunos a nomear fontes pessoais de inspiracao, como fotos, lembrancas e tecidos de familia.
items.translation_notes_pt: Explique como memoria pessoal ou lembranca, nao apenas capacidade mental.

vocabulary_groups.title: Mood and impression language
vocabulary_groups.description: Words for the feeling or final impression of a design.

items.definition_en: The feeling or atmosphere of the design.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The feeling the design gives.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A sensacao ou atmosfera que o design transmite.
items.example_sentence_en: The mood is calm.
items.example_sentence_pt: The mood is calm.
items.professional_context_en: Mood is the key word for linking visual choices to impression.
items.professional_context_pt: Mood e a palavra principal para ligar escolhas visuais a impressao.
items.translation_notes_pt: Ensine como atmosfera ou clima, nao apenas humor.

items.definition_en: Peaceful and not busy or loud.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Soft and peaceful.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Suave e tranquilo.
items.example_sentence_en: The blue palette feels calm.
items.example_sentence_pt: The blue palette feels calm.
items.professional_context_en: Calm supports soft color and flowy silhouette explanations.
items.professional_context_pt: Calm apoia explicacoes com cores suaves e silhuetas fluidas.
items.translation_notes_pt: Use como ponte para calmo ou tranquila dependendo do contexto.

items.definition_en: Strong, clear, and easy to notice.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Strong and easy to see.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Forte e facil de perceber.
items.example_sentence_en: The contrast makes the look bold.
items.example_sentence_pt: The contrast makes the look bold.
items.professional_context_en: Bold helps students explain contrast, structure, and strong urban styling.
items.professional_context_pt: Bold ajuda os alunos a explicar contraste, estrutura e estilo urbano forte.
items.translation_notes_pt: Pode ser ousado ou marcante, dependendo do exemplo.

items.definition_en: Fun, lively, and full of energy.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Fun and lively.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Divertido e cheio de energia.
items.example_sentence_en: The bright colors feel playful.
items.example_sentence_pt: The bright colors feel playful.
items.professional_context_en: Playful supports bright color and movement-based design explanations.
items.professional_context_pt: Playful apoia explicacoes de design baseadas em cores vivas e movimento.
items.translation_notes_pt: Use como ponte para divertido ou ludico.

items.definition_en: Refined, balanced, and graceful.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Beautiful in a refined way.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Bonito de forma refinada e equilibrada.
items.example_sentence_en: The overall look is elegant.
items.example_sentence_pt: The overall look is elegant.
items.professional_context_en: Elegant supports early portfolio language and more formal final impressions.
items.professional_context_pt: Elegant apoia a linguagem inicial de portfolio e impressoes finais mais formais.
items.translation_notes_pt: Use como ponte para elegante.

items.definition_en: Gentle, light, and not harsh in effect.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Gentle and light.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Suave e leve.
items.example_sentence_en: The fabric gives the look a soft effect.
items.example_sentence_pt: The fabric gives the look a soft effect.
items.professional_context_en: Soft helps students describe calm palettes, flowy shapes, and gentle final impressions.
items.professional_context_pt: Soft ajuda os alunos a descrever paletas calmas, formas fluidas e impressoes finais suaves.
items.translation_notes_pt: Use como ponte para suave, macio, ou delicado conforme o contexto visual.

items.definition_en: Powerful, clear, and visually firm.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Powerful and easy to notice.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Forte e facil de perceber.
items.example_sentence_en: The jacket creates a strong final look.
items.example_sentence_pt: The jacket creates a strong final look.
items.professional_context_en: Strong helps students describe firm structure, straight lines, and confident fashion impressions.
items.professional_context_pt: Strong ajuda os alunos a descrever estrutura firme, linhas retas e impressoes de moda confiantes.
items.translation_notes_pt: Use como ponte para forte no sentido visual, nao apenas fisico.

items.definition_en: Current, clean, and connected to contemporary style.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: New-looking and current in style.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Com cara atual e contemporanea.
items.example_sentence_en: The structured jacket looks modern.
items.example_sentence_pt: The structured jacket looks modern.
items.professional_context_en: Modern helps students explain urban styling, practical shapes, and current design impressions.
items.professional_context_pt: Modern ajuda os alunos a explicar estilo urbano, formas praticas e impressoes de design atuais.
items.translation_notes_pt: Use como ponte para moderno ou atual.

vocabulary_groups.title: Visual elements and design choices
vocabulary_groups.description: Words for the visible design choices students connect to inspiration.

items.definition_en: The overall shape of the garment or look.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The main shape of the look.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A forma principal do look.
items.example_sentence_en: The silhouette is loose and soft.
items.example_sentence_pt: The silhouette is loose and soft.
items.professional_context_en: Silhouette helps students connect inspiration to overall shape choices.
items.professional_context_pt: Silhouette ajuda os alunos a ligar inspiracao a escolhas de forma geral.
items.translation_notes_pt: Use como ponte para silhueta.

items.definition_en: The main group of colors used in the design.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The set of colors in the look.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: O conjunto de cores do look.
items.example_sentence_en: The palette is blue, green, and white.
items.example_sentence_pt: The palette is blue, green, and white.
items.professional_context_en: Palette supports portfolio-ready color explanation language.
items.professional_context_pt: Palette apoia a linguagem de explicacao de cor pronta para portfolio.
items.translation_notes_pt: Use como ponte para paleta.

items.definition_en: To select one design option.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: To pick one option.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Escolher uma opcao.
items.example_sentence_en: I chose a flowy fabric.
items.example_sentence_pt: I chose a flowy fabric.
items.professional_context_en: Choose is the key Week 12 verb for design rationale sentences.
items.professional_context_pt: Choose e o principal verbo da Semana 12 para frases de justificativa de design.
items.translation_notes_pt: Revise a forma fixa no passado em I chose ....
items.pronunciation_notes: Say CHOOZ; past form sounds like CHOHZ.

items.definition_en: To put a design element into the look.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: To put something in the design.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Colocar algo no design.
items.example_sentence_en: I used curved lines to show movement.
items.example_sentence_pt: I used curved lines to show movement.
items.professional_context_en: Use supports simple explanation of line, fabric, and detail choices.
items.professional_context_pt: Use apoia a explicacao simples de escolhas de linha, tecido e detalhe.
items.translation_notes_pt: Revise used em frases de justificativa.
items.pronunciation_notes: Say YOOZD in the past form used.

vocabulary_groups.title: Reason-giving and challenge terms
vocabulary_groups.description: High-frequency rationale phrases plus a few support-level concept words.

items.definition_en: A word used to give a reason.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A word for saying why.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma palavra para dizer por que.
items.example_sentence_en: I chose blue because it feels calm.
items.example_sentence_pt: I chose blue because it feels calm.
items.professional_context_en: Because is the main connector for beginner design-rationale writing.
items.professional_context_pt: Because e o principal conector para a escrita inicial de justificativa de design.
items.translation_notes_pt: Use como ponte para porque.

items.definition_en: Makes or produces an effect.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Makes an effect happen.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Faz um efeito acontecer.
items.example_sentence_en: This creates a calm mood.
items.example_sentence_pt: This creates a calm mood.
items.professional_context_en: Creates helps students explain visual effect in a simple complete sentence.
items.professional_context_pt: Creates ajuda os alunos a explicar efeito visual em uma frase simples e completa.
items.translation_notes_pt: Use como ponte para cria.

items.definition_en: The final general impression of the design.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The full final look of the design.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A impressao final e geral do design.
items.example_sentence_en: The overall look is modern and strong.
items.example_sentence_pt: The overall look is modern and strong.
items.professional_context_en: Overall look gives students one clear closing phrase for captions and short presentations.
items.professional_context_pt: Overall look oferece aos alunos uma frase final clara para captions e apresentacoes curtas.
items.translation_notes_pt: Use como ponte para visual geral ou impressao geral.

items.definition_en: A more abstract design idea.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A design idea that is more general or abstract.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma ideia de design mais geral ou abstrata.
items.example_sentence_en: The concept is soft movement.
items.example_sentence_pt: The concept is soft movement.
items.professional_context_en: Concept is useful for extension but should stay light in A2 tasks.
items.professional_context_pt: Concept e util para extensao, mas deve permanecer leve nas tarefas de nivel A2.
items.translation_notes_pt: Mantenha como termo de apoio, nao termo principal.

items.definition_en: The visible sense of motion or flow in a design.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The feeling that the design moves or flows.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A sensacao de que o design se move ou flui.
items.example_sentence_en: The wide sleeves show movement.
items.example_sentence_pt: The wide sleeves show movement.
items.professional_context_en: Movement helps students explain loose shapes, wide sleeves, and rhythm-based inspiration.
items.professional_context_pt: Movement ajuda os alunos a explicar formas soltas, mangas amplas e inspiracao baseada em ritmo.
items.translation_notes_pt: Explique como movimento visivel ou efeito de fluidez, nao apenas deslocamento fisico.
